errors.reason: Non-detection is plausible but frequency/platform behavior is not in provided primary records. source_supported_findings: Bounded additional source finding: HTTP hasEnvNotionToken checks truthiness of OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS; Docker default string {} is truthy although proxy resolves no headers when NOTION_TOKEN absent. With passthrough enabled a missing client token can bypass early missing-token rejection and proceed unauthenticated upstream. This is late failure, not cross-tenant authorization bypass (start-server.ts and proxy.ts).

Bounded additional source finding: Docker omits dev dependencies before build, but build needs devDependency typescript/esbuild; final image build viability needs controlled verification, not a statement about already deployed images.

errors.report_quote: A prompt-injected or malicious client can name `/etc/passwd`, `~/.ssh/id_rsa` or `.env` and have the file uploaded to Notion. Over HTTP, the file is read from the server host.
errors.reason: Shipped fixed spec has no multipart/binary operations; no client-controlled spec path. File-read helper is latent only. Also createReadStream does not expand ~. This promoted dead path drives the highest priority finding.

errors.report_quote: A missing file will surface later as an unhandled stream error rather than the intended "Failed to read file" message.
errors.reason: Synchronous try/catch cannot catch later stream events, but append passes stream into form-data which may forward errors into its own error handling/Axios. Dependency implementations absent; cannot conclude unhandled event/crash. Also latent in shipped configuration.
